finding: The bound manifest path validated one parsed input object and then passed the original input path to a downstream writer that reread it, leaving a time-of-check/time-of-use window between promotion and serialization.
design_implication: Downstream serialization must consume a read-only snapshot produced from the exact parsed object that passed the promotion gate, rather than rereading the caller-controlled input path.

snapshot_properties: digest and byte length returned in result

verified_behaviors: mutation of the caller's source object after snapshot creation does not alter downstream bytes
temporary snapshot cleanup occurs after downstream failure
invalid input and missing operation fail before snapshot creation

uncertainty: The full bound manifest integration suite was not executed in an authenticated repository checkout.
Filesystem protection cannot defend against a privileged actor capable of rewriting read-only temporary files.
This change binds the manifest input object; retained raw evidence files and execution declarations remain governed by their existing digest checks.
falsification_route: Run the committed test, then add a controlled integration harness that mutates the original input path after promotion and prove the emitted manifest retains the promoted object and reports its snapshot digest.
privacy_boundary: No credentials, private source payloads, personal content, or raw authenticated enumeration output are retained in this record.
